5 world class wine regions within an hour and winemakers available to share their personal experiences one on one, the worlds largest surviving koala population in the wild, natural Artesian spring fed hot pools on the side of Mount Lofty, and of course the sharing of our story here starting with the oldest surviving culture going through Arthur Hardy's gatsby-esque years of celebration to today - all on a long table with a glass of Adelaide Hills red, complete with campfire on the valley rim at sunset, surrounded by kangaroos and wallabies. And that’s just day one.

Sequoia Lodge focuses on money can't buyn behind the scenes experiences in our beautiful region. These will centre around our brand pillars of food and wine, nature, wellness and history. Guests will come from all over the world, and initially from around the country seeking experiences that simply aren't available anywhere else in the world.

Also on Mount Lofty Estate sits the iconic manor Mount Lofty House was the most awarded hotel in Australia in 2019 and #1 hotel in South Australia according to Tripadvisor and the Australian Hotel Association Awards. Add a 3 Chef Hat restaurant, vineyards, 30 acres of gardens, day spa and cocktail bar, all perched on Mount Lofty Summit, only 15 minutes from Adelaide CBD and it simply sounds too good to be true. 

Our estate requires a Night Manager to assist in the overnight operations of both Sequoia Lodge and Mount Lofty House. These operations will be overnight focused on the night audit task list, in addition to reception, in room dining, and public area cleaning in the lodge and at Mount Lofty House. This role will work as part of the larger Mount Lofty Estate team reporting to the Assistant Lodge Manager, and working closely with other key department heads in the delivery of excellence. 

We believe in Old Fashioned hospitality, honesty and respect, team work, ownership, flexibility and passion being genuine in our care for others. The team love what we do, and having a lot of fun along the way is a must.

Our Night Manager will have direct responsibility for:
Ensure the safety and security of the property and the smooth and efficient running of the estate’s overnight operation
Effectively manage the daily reconciliation details of the estate’s trading
Conduct the night audit and oversee financial controls such as revenue auditing, account payable, and credit card transactions.
Collaborate with hotel management to monitor financial performance, identify discrepancies, and implement improvements.
Effective coordination and supervision of all guest arrivals and departures

Cleaning the lodge reception and lounge bar areas
Support the night cleaner in their role cleaning all other areas of the hotel
Effectively communicate with all departments of the hotel to ensure customer satisfaction is consistently achieved
Utilise the Front Office PMS to meet operational needs and produce accurate reports
Deliver outstanding service to guests of Mount Lofty House and Sequoia taking care of any requests during the shift
Prepare and deliver in room dining to guests overnight.

You will have the following: 
Previous leadership experience in a similar environment
In depth knowledge of Front Office standards and procedures
Authentic customer service, interpersonal & communication skills & be flexible in your approach
Impeccable grooming and presentation
Excellent organisation and time management
Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suite
Experience with a PMS - Protel or Opera preferred but not essential
Available to work weekdays and weekends including shift work

Sound exciting? We look forward to meeting you.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Are you a finance professional with a proven track record for turning complex data into meaningful insights and influencing strategic decisions?

We are recruiting an exciting role as a Senior Corporate Analysis Manager to join our Planning & Performance team on a permanent full-time basis.

Based at Macquarie Park, the successful candidate will play a key role in Anglicare's financial sustainability and growth by delivering high-quality financial modelling, capital allocation analysis and planning insights. Working closely with senior stakeholders across the organisation, you will provide the analysis and forecasting that informs investment decisions, funding strategies and long-term business planning.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to:

Work on high-impact growth-driven projects that influence organisational decision-making.

Partner with senior leaders across a large and diverse organisation.

Apply your financial modelling expertise to complex investment and capital planning decisions.

Contribute to finance transformation initiatives that improve reporting, systems and business insights.

Make a difference by applying your commercial expertise in a purpose-driven organisation making a positive impact in the community.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain long-range three-way financial models covering cash flow, profit and loss, and balance sheet forecasts.

Deliver investment analysis including IRR, NPV, payback and scenario modelling.

Lead the ongoing management, governance and continuous improvement of Anglicare's capital management framework.

Provide financial insights that support capital allocation, funding and operational decision-making.

Prepare and present financial insights and reporting to support Executive and Board-level decision making.

Align long-term planning assumptions with annual budgets and quarterly forecasts.

Support treasury activities through cash flow forecasting and covenant modelling.

Ensure the integrity and accuracy of financial modelling data, assumptions and reporting outputs.

Collaborate with Finance and Digital Technology teams to ensure best in class systems and reporting.

Key Skills

Advanced financial modelling and forecasting capability.

Strong commercial and business acumen.

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to confidently communicate financial information to a range of stakeholders.

Experience preparing insights and recommendations to support investment decisions.

Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.

Experience with finance systems, BI tools and planning platforms.

Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on process optimisation.

What you'll bring

You are a commercially minded finance professional with a proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholder, influencing decision-making and delivering insights that drive sustainable business outcomes.

You will also need:

Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification or equivalent is essential.

CFA qualification highly regarded.

10+ years' finance experience, ideally within FP&A, corporate finance or financial modelling environments.

Proven experience building financial models in complex scenarios and presenting meaningful insights.

Experience supporting capital investment, business planning and forecasting activities.

Experience supporting treasury activities, capital funding decisions, covenant modelling or investment analysis will be highly regarded.

Strong technical capability across Excel, Power BI and planning systems.

Exposure to capital-intensive industries such as property, infrastructure, healthcare or aged care will be highly regarded.

Why Anglicare?

We provide meaningful opportunities and choice, both for the individuals and communities we support and the dedicated people here who make it happen.

At Anglicare, you'll get the security, stability and opportunities that come with a strong, well-established organisation that's ready for the future. You'll belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds. You will also be supported to gain new knowledge, deepen your experience and expertise, and shape a rewarding career.

On top of that, here are just some of the tangible benefits you will enjoy in a career with us:

Flexible, supportive work environment that provides the opportunity to do the best most rewarding work of your life

Hybrid working arrangements 2-3 days in the office

Opportunities for career progression, professional development and training

Treehouse benefits and rewards, including discounts to 400 retail, accommodation and entertainment

Fitness Passport with discounts to over 800 gyms for you and your family

Tax benefits through salary packaging options as a not-for-profit organisation

Free on-site parking

A safe and healthy workplace culture

Are you ready for a career that means more?

To apply for this role, please click the 'Apply' button. All applicants will receive a response.

Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While we are guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others, and we value the diverse perspectives they bring. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds.

Alba Italian Restaurant is seeking an experienced full-time Waiter to join our front-of-house team in Newtown.
Alba is an independently operated Italian restaurant specialising in the food and hospitality of Southern Italy. We are looking for a professional hospitality employee who can provide knowledgeable, attentive and welcoming table service.

About the role
The Waiter will provide full table service, assist guests with menu and beverage selections and work closely with the kitchen and front-of-house team to deliver a consistent dining experience.
The position requires availability across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Main responsibilities
Welcome guests and provide professional table service.
Explain menu items, ingredients, monthly specials and dietary options.
Take accurate food and beverage orders.
Enter orders correctly into the point-of-sale system.
Serve food, wine and other beverages in accordance with restaurant standards.
Provide appropriate food and wine recommendations.
Monitor tables throughout the dining experience.
Communicate guest requests and dietary requirements clearly to the kitchen.
Process bills and customer payments accurately.
Set up and reset the dining room before, during and after service.
Maintain clean and organised dining and service areas.
Assist with stock handling and basic beverage preparation.
Respond professionally to guest questions, requests and complaints.
Comply with responsible service of alcohol, food safety, and workplace health and safety requirements. 
Skills and experience

Applicants should have:
At least 2 years of relevant restaurant service experience.
Experience providing full table service in a busy restaurant.
Strong knowledge of food, wine and beverage service.
Excellent communication and customer-service skills.
The ability to carry multiple plates and manage several tables efficiently.
Strong attention to detail and order accuracy.
The ability to work calmly and professionally during busy services.
A current NSW Responsible Service of Alcohol certificate.
Availability to work evenings, weekends and public holidays.
Knowledge of Italian food, Italian wine or Italian-style service will be highly regarded.

Employment conditions
Permanent, full-time employment.
Salary between $79,500 and $85,000 based on experience
Approximately 38 hours per week, with reasonable additional hours where required.
Evening, weekend and public-holiday work will be required.

How to apply
Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant restaurant experience, knowledge of food and wine and current availability.
Applications will be assessed on demonstrated skills and experience.

This established medical practice, situated in a thriving coastal suburb of New South Wales, is seeking a dedicated General Practitioner to join its vibrant and rapidly growing team. The clinic offers a modern and supportive environment where practitioners enjoy full clinical autonomy, allowing them to focus entirely on high-quality patient care. Located within a major shopping precinct, the facility is highly accessible and features fifteen consulting rooms along with a fully equipped, modernized four-bed treatment room. The practice is technology-driven, utilizing Best Practice software and HotDoc for seamless online appointments, while offering onsite pathology and allied health services for comprehensive patient management. 

 The team composition is young and energetic, guided by seasoned medical practitioners at the management level who are committed to the holistic growth of their staff. Doctors are supported by an experienced nursing team and a proficient administrative department, with dedicated assistance available for Chronic Disease Management (CDM) and complex care coordination. For those interested in professional advancement, the practice provides ample support for Continuing Professional Development (CPD) and offers pathways for clinical leadership and supervisor opportunities. Practitioners with special interests are encouraged to develop their niche within the diverse and expanding patient base. 

 Financial rewards and lifestyle balance are key features of this role, with a competitive billing structure of 70% to 75% and a minimum income guarantee. The practice offers significant flexibility, including various working arrangements and remote access to accommodate individual needs. As a DPA/MM1 location, it presents an excellent opportunity for both permanent and locum doctors to establish themselves in a high-demand area. 

 The lifestyle benefits of the Shellharbour region are exceptional, making it a premier destination for families and outdoor enthusiasts alike. Practitioners can enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle with easy access to stunning beaches, the vibrant village waterfront, and scenic nature reserves such as Bass Point and Killalea State Park. With excellent local schools, diverse dining options, and a friendly community atmosphere, the location provides the perfect balance between a rewarding professional career and a high quality of life by the sea.
